2. **All pathways interconnected** — the transfer pathway (R1) shares nodes with: the dead-end pathway (via "Existence of simple domain-specific tricks..."), the interpretability pathway (via "Weight sharing across action modules..."→sparse-policy evidence), the receptive-field pathway (via "Generalising convolution..."→P7 and "Skip connections..."→depth rationale), the distribution-shift pathway (via the imitation design rationale and "Cumulative coverage..." evidence), the scalability pathway (via "Generalising convolution..."→P11), and the language-coverage pathway (via "Relatedness of ground actions and propositions..."→P12).
3. **No isolated or duplicate nodes** — every one of the 83 nodes appears in at least one edge; "Teacher planner call caching…" and "Augmenting action modules with pooling…" each terminate into an intervention, and every intervention has at least one incoming edge.
4. **Framework decomposition** — ASNets are never represented as a single black-box node; they are decomposed into relatedness, action/proposition weight tying, position-aware pooling, skip connections, masked softmax, input feature vector, heuristic inputs, and the separate training/exploitation mechanisms.
5. **JSON integrity** — all `source_node`/`target_node` strings are verbatim copies of `name` fields; concept nodes carry null intervention fields and interventions carry null `concept_category`.
